=LET(
  values, COL_VALUES(S_BUDGET, "category"),
  years, COL_VALUES(S_BUDGET, "year"),
  positions, SEQUENCE(ROWS(values)),
  ARRAYFORMULA(
    IF(years<>"", "",
      IFNA(
        LOOKUP(
          positions,
          positions / (values <> ""),
          values
        ),
        ""
      )
    )
  )
)

=LET(
  budget_year, BUDGET_VALUE("_year"),
  prior_rows, INDEX(S_BUDGET, 1, 1):INDEX(
    S_BUDGET,
    ROW() - ROW(INDEX(S_BUDGET, 1, 1)),
    COLUMNS(S_BUDGET)
  ),
  current_funding, SUM(
    FILTER(
      ARRAYFORMULA(
        IN_LOAN_PARAM_VALUES_BY_LOAN("totals", "total in loans received") +
        OUT_LOAN_PARAM_VALUES_BY_LOAN("totals", "total out loan repayments received") +
        REVENUE_PARAM_VALUES("total revenue")
      ),
      ARRAYFORMULA(YEAR(R_MONTHS)) = budget_year
    )
  ),
  carry_forward, SUM(
    FILTER(
      COL_VALUES(prior_rows, "Headroom"),
      COL_VALUES(prior_rows, "Year") = budget_year - 1
    )
  ),
  current_funding + carry_forward
)
